overview:
Rep. Norma Torres, a Democrat seeking another term in this Inland Empire district, faces Republican Mike Cargile in the general election. Torres advanced past the primary and holds a commanding financial position, having raised roughly $885,000 with about $364,000 on hand, while Cargile has raised under $10,000 and has less than $1,000 available. Outside spending in the race has been negligible so far.

The district's six-point Democratic lean, combined with Torres's incumbency and her lopsided resource advantage, points to a comfortable win. Prediction markets price her chances at about 98 percent. No public polls of the general election are available, so the outlook rests on fundamentals, but the gap in money and the seat's lean make an upset a long shot. Torres is favored by roughly 19 points.
